candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis is a composite: lepromatous leprosy PLUS type 2 leprosy reaction (T2R). The clinical record supports T2R through the painful nodules on upper arms, joint swelling/synovitis, uveitis, lymphadenopathy, and splenomegaly — all classic features of erythema nodosum leprosum. C001 captures only the parent disease without the reactive complication, which is a required component of the full diagnostic object.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies lepromatous leprosy but omits the required type 2 leprosy reaction (erythema nodosum leprosum) component

case_quality_flags: Composite diagnosis requires both lepromatous leprosy and type 2 leprosy reaction (ENL) to be complete
Elevated rheumatoid factor in leprosy is a known false-positive association and supports the diagnosis
